topic: The approval request boundary is not built: replay-safe requests, project-level authorisation and boundary audit
what_remains_open: CF-22 stays open. Beyond the version, digest and proposal reference now carried by the approval token, a real approval screen or API needs a request boundary that is safe to repeat (a request identifier whose repeat returns the first result), that authorises the approver for the finding's project (the project permission model is an Engine decision, EDR-29) and that refuses another tenant's records, with each outcome audited. None of this exists. Blueprint Section 15 requires authorisation on every request and replay protection where relevant.
what_this_package_shows: approve_action fails closed on a missing or stale version, digest or proposal reference; a second submission of the same approval is refused as not allowed (safe, but not a repeat of the first answer); the scoped store refuses another tenant's records. No project-level check exists; any holder of the approver role in a tenant can approve a finding of any project in it.
who_must_act: Builder (first slice of M9, the API contract, in a later release); Amir (Engine build); the auditor (integration test)
